testcase.name: Scenario: Escape the open target selector with an unapplied addition: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:963:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Escape the open target selector with an unapplied addition ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target ✔ When the user double-clicks "2D Sketches" in the available list ✔ Then the Part Tools target has a pending-change marker ✔ And "2D Sketches" appears in the custom panel list ✔ When the user opens the custom panel target selector ✔ And the user presses Down to highlight Part Manage ✔ And the user presses Escape ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no User Commands panel is visible on the Tools ribbon ✔ When the user reopens Ribbon customization ✔ Then the Part Tools custom panel list is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in the source list ✔ And the Part Tools target has no pending-change marker
